analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free caused by freeing the same underlying refcounted object through two compiled variables during function-leave cleanup. i_free_compiled_variables() blindly calls i_zval_ptr_dtor() on each CV slot in sequence; in this PoV, one CV destruction releases a SplFixedArray object (via rc_dtor_func -> zend_objects_store_del), while another CV still holds a reference wrapper/path that points to the already-freed storage, leading to a second destructor path that reaches zend_reference_destroy() and GC_DELREF on freed memory (crash observed in zend_gc_delref at zend_types.h:1342).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzed script must create aliasing/reference relationships among locals (CVs), including SplFixedArray element references (e.g., $g =& $b[0]) and then trigger exceptional/unwind leave handling (stack includes zend_dispatch_try_catch_finally_helper_SPEC / ZEND_HANDLE_EXCEPTION_SPEC_HANDLER). During unwind, compiled variable cleanup runs and dtors are invoked in an order where one CV frees the object and another CV still references related refcounted data, causing a stale pointer dereference on subsequent CV destruction.
